connectorUiConfig.title: Microsoft Intune (Diagnostic Settings)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Collects Microsoft Intune / MDM management data via **Intune Diagnostic Settings** streaming to Log Analytics. Populates four tables used by the **Intune Logs** Sentinel solution's analytic rules, hunting queries, and CIO/CISO workbook: `IntuneAuditLogs`, `IntuneOperationalLogs`, `IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg`, `IntuneDevices`. This is the Microsoft-recommended ingestion path (no secrets, no polling, no app registration required).

sampleQueries.description: All Intune audit events in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query:
IntuneAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| project TimeGenerated, Identity, OperationName, ResultType, Properties
| order by TimeGenerated desc

IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by tostring(DeviceId)
| where ComplianceState != 'Compliant'
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, UserPrincipalName, ComplianceState, OSDescription

IntuneAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where OperationName has 'enroll'
| summarize Enrollments = count() by Identity = tostring(Identity)
| order by Enrollments desc

IntuneOperationalLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Result has_any ('Fail','Error')
| summarize Count = count() by OperationName
| order by Count desc

value: union isfuzzy=true IntuneAuditLogs, IntuneOperationalLogs, IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg, IntuneDevices | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated) | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(14d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions on the workspace are required for diagnostic settings target.

customs.name: Intune Administrator or Global Administrator
customs.description: Required in the Microsoft Entra tenant to configure Intune diagnostic settings. See [Intune Administrator role](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/permissions-reference).

customs.name: Log Analytics Contributor
customs.description: Required on the destination workspace to write diagnostic settings. See [Manage access](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/manage-access).

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 - Open Intune Diagnostic settings
instructionSteps.description:
1. Sign in to the [Microsoft Intune admin center](https://intune.microsoft.com).
2. Go to **Reports** > **Diagnostic settings**.
3. If prompted, **Turn on** diagnostic logging for Intune, then click **+ Add diagnostic setting**.

instructionSteps.title: Step 2 - Select log categories
instructionSteps.description:
Give the diagnostic setting a name (e.g. `Microsoft Sentinel Intune Logs`). Under **Logs to send** select **all four** categories required by the Intune Logs solution:
- `AuditLogs`
- `OperationalLogs`
- `DeviceComplianceOrg`
- `Devices`

Optional categories (enable if used):
- `Windows365AuditLogs` (Cloud PC)

instructionSteps.title: Step 3 - Select destination workspace
instructionSteps.description: Under **Destination details**, check **Send to Log Analytics workspace**. Select the Azure subscription and the Microsoft Sentinel-enabled workspace (e.g. `lawsentinel`). Click **Save**.

instructionSteps.title: Step 4 - Verify ingestion
instructionSteps.description: Within ~15 minutes new data should appear. Run the query below in the workspace to confirm. If the connector shows as connected here, you are done.
